📢⚖️ We’re Looking for a Junior Advocate | Patna High Court
Position: Junior Advocate
 Location: Patna High Court, Patna
 Experience: Freshers / Junior Advocates interested in litigation
Work & Learning Areas:
 • Legal research & case-law reading
 • Drafting petitions, applications & legal notices
 • Filing & e-filing
 • Court proceedings & mentioning
 • Case preparation and briefing
 • Civil, Criminal, Family & Writ matters
What I’m Looking For:
 ✓ Sincere & hardworking
 ✓ Willingness to learn
 ✓ Good drafting and research skills
 ✓ Regular availability for Court work
 ✓ Professional attitude & commitment
This is an opportunity for a young advocate who wants to learn practical High Court litigation and build a strong foundation in legal practice.
📍 Patna High Court, Patna, Bihar
Adv. Smriti Tiwari
 Advocate, Patna High Court
